newsitem.title: USA: CME October live cattle fall on pre-report selling.
newsitem.headline: CME October live cattle fall on pre-report selling.

text.p: CME October live cattle futures tumbled on commercial selling and unwinding of bull spreads ahead of Friday's USDA Cattle-on-Feed report and sell stops were hit, traders said.
Refco Inc and R.J. O'Brien were said to be notable sellers early, traders said.
The market had fallen as much as 0.900 cent a lb when sell stops pushed prices down further but futures recovered somewhat as selling waned, traders said
At 1038 CDT, live cattle were 0.675 to 0.100 cent a lb lower with October down 0.675 at 71.825 cents.
